senses.gloss: m.(b. h. גָּדֵר; גדר)fence, guard, precaution against trespassing the law.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 1:2:4">Y. Dem. I, 21ᵈ</cite> <he>מפני גְדֵירָהּ</he>, <he>מפני גְדֵירוֹ</he> in order to guard it against transgressing.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 79">Gen. R. s. 79</cite> (<he>גְּדֵרָן</he>) <he>פרצת גְּדֵירָן של וכ׳</he> thou hast broken down the guard (enactment) which the scholars have erected; a. fr.
